notes.text: The owner sent Pani Agata (mba@poczta.wshifm.edu.pl) his questions for an MBA defense ('Obrona - MBA'), covering three topics: controlling in the enterprise, ratio analysis, and the presentation of financial analysis instruments.

The owner's MBA defense questions on controlling ask about the split of functions between controlling and accounting, how controlling differs from internal and external auditing, and the advantages and drawbacks of activity-based costing (ABC).

The owner's MBA defense questions on ratio analysis and financial analysis ask about the limits of ratio analysis, pyramid analysis, predicting bankruptcy with ratios, and the classification of economic ratios used to assess firms.

The owner told Pani Agata that on Tuesday, 3 April, he flies to Philadelphia in the morning and expects to reach his hotel around 12 local time (6:00 pm Polish time). He apparently needs to take part in the defense from there.
notes.quote: We wtorek, 3 kwietnia rano, wylatuje do Filadelfii.

notes.text: The owner promised to send Pani Agata a detailed travel plan with the hotel address and number the next day. He asked her for a phone number he can call to give his room number or to report a flight delay.
